caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate sofa positioned against a pale cream-colored wall with a white baseboard. The sofa has a wooden frame featuring elaborate carved patterns along its top edge, arms, and legs. The wood is a warm brown color, with intricate detailing visible throughout the frame. The upholstery of the sofa is a muted grayish-purple color with a subtle, patterned texture and vertical channel tufting along the backrest. The seat cushion appears seamless, matching the same color and pattern as the rest of the upholstery. The floor beneath the sofa is a muted teal or blue-green color. In the lower right corner, the artist's name "Eugene Choe" is visible in a matching teal color. There are no other objects or details in the drawing.
title: Rosewood Sofa
